text:
Type: tall grey glass-door cabinet
Use: displaying china, glassware, books or collections; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: grey painted wood, clear glass doors and sides, glass shelves, small dark knobs, grooved back panel
Colors: soft mid grey, clear glass
Shape: tall upright vitrine with a molded crown, two glass doors with three panes each, glazed sides, scalloped plinth base, stately and light
Feel: calm, elegant, timeless, soft
Goes with: white walls, silver, linen, pale blue or sage accents; classic, traditional or farmhouse dining and living rooms

product.name: LIATORP
product.description: 3 adjustable glass shelves; adjust spacing according to your own storage needs.
